discovered_issues.title: 13 backwpup UNCERTAIN findings involve >1-hop dispatch chains not resolved by 1-hop extension
discovered_issues.root_cause_analysis: resolvePropertyCallChain() resolves $this->property->method() only. Some REST EP callbacks dispatch through multi-level chains: e.g., $this->cloud_provider_manager->get_provider() returns an object of type CloudProviderInterface, then $provider->authenticate() is called on the returned object. This requires: (1) resolving the return type of get_provider(), (2) looking up the concrete class implementing CloudProviderInterface in this context, (3) resolving authenticate() in that class. This is multi-hop class type inference — significantly more complex than constructor injection lookup.
discovered_issues.fix_path: Accept as known limitation of 1-hop static analysis for DI-pattern architectures, OR extend resolvePropertyCallChain to follow method return types (requires PHP docblock/return-type parsing). Estimated 150-200 lines PHP, HIGH complexity. Recommend accepting current state: 9 CONFIRMED is a strong Wave 4 result. 13 UNCERTAIN are not FP — they are genuinely uncertain due to IR depth limits.
